summary: Conditional teardown helper. When the byte flag at this+0xC is non-zero, frees the inner heap block stored at this+0. When bit 0 of a2 is set, frees the container object itself. Returns the original this pointer unchanged. Called by sub_495300 during object/container teardown.

operations.description: Test the byte flag at this+0xC; when non-zero, the inner block is freed.
Free the inner heap block: FreeWrapper_7bcf(*(void**)this).
Test bit 0 of a2 ((a2 & 1) != 0); when set, the container object itself is freed.

unresolved: Semantics of the flag at this+0xC (owner-side ownership marker) is not established.
Whether a2 is a destructor flag or an explicit free request depends on the caller sub_495300.
